meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能诊断容器化代理的运行问题。它会检查日志、会话数据库和容器状态，帮助排查故障。
howto.when: 当用户报告容器失败、认证错误或想了解容器系统工作原理时触发。

say.text: 检查容器日志，帮我看看报错。
say.note: Claude 会读取日志文件并分析错误。

say.text: 查看会话数据库中的消息流。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can diagnose issues with containerized agent execution. It inspects logs, session databases, and container status to troubleshoot problems.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users report container failures, authentication errors, or want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.note: Claude reads log files and analyzes errors.

say_en.text: Inspect message flow in session DBs.
say_en.note: Claude queries inbound and outbound databases.
Claude runs ncl groups restart command.
